en.title: gr
en.summary: This is the letter L339 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The sound gr
paragraphs: The letters gr make one blend. You hear this sound in (green) /ɡriːn/, which is the colour of grass. This pair has one main sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Release the air while your voice is on. Immediately pull the tongue back and curl the tip slightly backward. Keep your voice box vibrating. Put your hand on your throat to feel the buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The letters gr appear at the beginning or in the middle of a word as a consonant cluster. A consonant cluster means two consonants side by side. You hear this cluster in (great) /ɡreɪt/. You also hear it in (grow) /ɡroʊ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not roll your tongue like a trill. A trill is when the tongue taps many times very fast. Keep your tongue from touching the roof of your mouth during the second part. Let the air flow smoothly without tapping.
